verses.ya-l-lahu-anta-l-ilahu-l-wahidu-l-ahadu-: yā llāhu ʾanta l-ʾilahu l-wāḥidu l-ʾaḥadu yā llāhu yā barru yā mawlāyā yā ṣamadu
yā dhā l-jalāli wal-ʾikrāmi l-faʿūli limā yurīduhu ḥayyu yā qayyūmu yā fardu
waʾanta yā llāhu yā laṭīfu muqtadiru ʾanta r-raʾūfu r-raḥīmu l-māniʿu s-sanadu
yā llāhu yā llāhu yā maljaʾa l-ʿufāti wayā man kāna yarjūhu mazʾūdu wamuktamidu
ʾanṣur ʾamīra juyūshi l-muslimīna ʿalā man ḥārabūhu waman ʿādū waman ḥasadū
najla lladhī ḥajja bayta llāhi mushtahirā biwaṣfihi rabbi yā mawlāyā yā shahidu
huwa l-waliyyū lladhī lā shayʾa yuzʿijuhu ʿan naṣri dīnika murdi kulla man ʿadadū
wallā wasāfara ʿan "ḥalwāra" maskanihi "likarta" yaṣḥabuhu ṣabru kadhā jaladu
ḥajja wahājira thumma baʿdu jāhadahum karrat waghārat ʿalayhim khayluhu l-jurudu
(faʾaṣbaḥū lā tarā ʾillā masākinahum) yā dhulla man kafarū billāhi wat-taḥadū
wallā wahum yatakhāfatūna baynahum ʾayna l-mafarru lanā yā ʾayyuhā l-ḥushudu
wakāna min qablu mulqā min warāʾihimi lakinnahu lam yazal billāhi yaʿtaḍidu
mustaʿṭifā mustaʿīthā khāshiʿā mutawā ḍiʿā wamustanṣirā mawlāhu yaʿtamidu
ʾiʿlāʾa kalmatihi l-ʿulyā bilā fakhari man yanṣuri llāha yunṣir ḥaythu yamtakidu
wāstaftaḥa l-bāba ʾahla (talbi) law ʿalimū mā yaʿqubu l-fatḥu ʾaymu llāhi mā baʿidū
wayḥa l-muʿassili mukhtābā wakāna lahu lasʿu z-zanābīri wat-takhyīru wal-kamadu
ʾarāhumu sh-shaykhu ʾamrā min ʾaʿājibihi warāzahum khulfu ẓanni baʿdahu l-baʿadu
ʾaʿṭāhumu l-māla thumma baʿda ʾanḥalahum jarḥā waqatlā waʾasrā dhalika ṣ-ṣamadu
fatuṣbiḥu l-ʾarḍu - yā llāhi - mukhḍarata yaʿʿumuhā l-ʾamnu wal-ʾislāmu war-raghadu
ʾakrim biman sāqa ʾahla (fūta) jullahumu fajāhidū kulla ʾābī d-dīni wājtahadū
yā ḥabbadhā bnu saʿīdi sayyidī ʿumaru yā ḥabbadhā ḥabbadhā yā ḥabbadhā l-waladu
niʿma l-walīdu ʾidhā mā ḥadhwa wad-dihi yaḥdhūhu yā fawza man dānū waman rashadū
niʿma l-khalīfatu naṣru d-dīni qudwatunā qadi ntahā l-jawru wal-ʾishrāku wan-nakadu
ʾaʿnī bihi ʾaḥmada l-maʿrūfa sayyidanā quṭba raḥā d-dīni yā waylā liman jaḥadū
wasāʿidā d-dīni mamdūdāni yā lahumā wash-shamsu ṭāliʿahu wal-badru muttaqidu
waghādarūhu wasal ʿammā badā lahumu min hulkahi wahurūbi ʾidh humu qaṣadū
yā rubba man kāna yahdīhi limahlakahi ḥadīthu nafsi ʾatāhu dh-dhullu wal-wabadu
wāhā lishibli waliyyi qāma mujtahidā yakfī dawāhiyā kufri kullamā taridu
mustankifā hadma mā banāhu maḥtiduhu kaʾannahu lam yaghib ʿan dīninā l-ʾasadu
lā zāla yaghzū wajundu llāhi yuʾuziruhu mahmā yukābiru man ʿādū waman ḥaqadū
thumma ʿalā r-raḥmahi l-ʿuẓmā saʿādatinā wal-ʾāli waṣ-ṣaḥbi suḥbi l-khayri man rashadū
ṣalli wasallim salāmā dāʾimā ʾabadā yā llāhu yā barru yā raḥmānu yā ṣamadu
